text: The student can choose a duration of study of 2-6 weeks and classes can be specially designed according to the requirements of the students. Regular classes are taught from Monday to Friday morning(20 class hours per week). The afternoons feature cultural activities (Chinese calligraphy, Chinese painting, Chinese Kung Fu, paper-cutting and Chinese film appreciation, etc.) and practice of Chinese traditional culture activities. At the end of the program, students who pass the examination will receive a Certificate of Completion. It is highly welcomed to receive students for at least 10 each time.
